label: Physical Works
description:
A collection of wearable artefacts and functional morphologies investigating how physical identity is constructed, altered and perceived from external points of view.

Through systems of mutation, enhancement, protection, and contradiction, these works approach the body as an interface between internal experience and external interpretation. Each object modifies the silhouette, introducing new anatomical structures that can redirect the way a body is read.

These artefacts emerge from a continuous exchange between digital speculation and material experimentation. Forms initially developed through digital modelling are translated through hybrid fabrication processes.

This transition from image to matter tests how speculative body architectures can become tangible and functional, transforming imagined anatomies into objects that physically negotiate materiality, and perception.
